decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app builds directly on the firm's core dental software knowledge, is its flagship line, and in-house R&D lets it keep learning from users and improving it as practices digitalise.

The continuing education institute draws on long-standing training content and practitioner relationships, giving the firm a channel to absorb customer needs at modest cost, even if the pandemic disrupted in-person courses.
The remote screen-sharing support tool lies within the firm's established support competence and became even more valuable for remote service, so it is cheap to keep and easy to improve.
The practice performance analytics dashboard uses the data and workflow knowledge already in the firm's practice software, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it with its own R&D.
The complete practice bundle packages existing core offerings that the firm understands well, so it supports sales to new practices at little extra cost.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's software knowledge, which limits its ability to learn from and improve it, but it is cheap to run and ties customers to the ecosystem, so it is kept for now under scrutiny.
